description: Create a sacred grove to expand nature's domain

ai_assignment_context.assignment_prompt: You have shown respect for nature's gifts, tender of growth. Now create something lasting - a sacred grove where life may flourish under your protection. Plant the seeds of tomorrow and tend them well.
completion_phrases: The Grove Guardian's blessing flows through your hands - you are become a keeper of the sacred green...
New life springs forth at your touch, and the forest spirits welcome a true tender of groves...

commands: tellraw {player} {"text":"🌳 The Grove Guardian's blessing awakens within you","color":"dark_green"}
